interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts reviews ideas, synopses, scripts, images, music videos, ads, animation and cuts. It explains the project as a whole in clear language: what already works, what fails, what has not been developed, and why. Evidence and deep production-department knowledge support a readable argument, concrete next steps and a relevant studio scope. The creator retains their intent and constraints. Private beta; real host execution and independent professional acceptance remain separate requirements.
